review_fixes_addressed: R-4 (major, T-0576 review, OPEN->CLOSED): anti-case-lock.sh count_literal() matcher was double-quote-only, blind to web/src/'s single-quote convention. 5 real code-only occurrences were invisible pre-fix: 'role-approver' in web/src/screens/screen-inbox.jsx:835 (t.role === 'role-approver'), 'approvalRequired' x4 in web/src/canvas/gateway-condition-panel.jsx:55/87/90 (default routing var fallback chain) and web/src/screens/screen-dmn-editor.jsx:47 (DEFAULT_ROUTING_NAME). Fixed: matcher widened to a quote-agnostic character class covering double/single/backtick quotes, applied uniformly to all 8 denylist literals (no per-literal special-casing). Baseline recounted as FACT by running the new matcher on this branch's own HEAD (not transcribed from the review's textual estimate, per this task's mandate): role-approver 2->3, approvalRequired 1->5, aggregate 19->24; the other 6 literals unchanged (no single-quoted pre-existing occurrences exist for them). Verified live via --self-test (new assertions 6/7 in the harness) with synthetic single-quoted plants in both src/ and web/src/.

ECO-1 (T-0576 test-report finding, foreign check T-0572, OPEN->CLOSED): rights-ui-anti-case.sh's PROJECT_ROOT resolved to ${SCRIPT_DIR}/.. = <repo>/ci (one level short of repo root) instead of ${SCRIPT_DIR}/../.. — the git diff/ls-files pathspec 'web/src/' therefore always resolved against a nonexistent ci/web/src/, the scan was ALWAYS empty, and the gate was structurally always-green regardless of diff content (proved live by T-0576's own test-phase: an untracked plant passed exit 0). Fixed with a single-line correction to match the idiom already used by read-pdp-anti-case.sh:26 and anti-case-lock.sh:70. Verified live: --self-test unaffected (synthetic temp-repo fixtures don't depend on the real PROJECT_ROOT); production run on the CLEAN task/T-0596-lock-harden branch stays green (diff-scoped semantics correctly ignore R-4's pre-existing single-quoted occurrences, which are not in this branch's diff — this is the expected, mandated behaviour, not a regression); production run WITH a fresh untracked plant in web/src/ now correctly FAILs (proving the pathspec resolution is fixed). Per the task's explicit semantics-check requirement: confirmed the gate is git-diff-scoped (git diff <base_ref> -- web/src/ + untracked files), NOT a repo-wide baseline — R-4's pre-existing hits are legitimately out of its diff-scoped detection range post-fix, by design, not by residual bug.

R-5 (minor, T-0576 review, OPEN->CLOSED): count_literal()/read_baseline()'s outer grep stage masked rc>=2 (a real grep error: missing/unreadable root, permission denied) under the same blanket `|| true` that legitimately absorbs rc=1 (no-match, the R-1 zero-safety fix) — a silent fail-open into '0 OK (eroded)' on a broken root. Fixed: rc is now captured explicitly; rc=0/1 remain data (R-1 zero-safety behaviour unchanged — verified no regression via existing self-test assertions 4/5), rc>=2 is now FATAL with an explicit error message identifying the failing root/literal and a non-zero script exit. Verified live via two new --self-test assertions: an unreadable-file fixture (chmod 000, portable across BSD and GNU grep — a nonexistent directory alone was ruled out as the fixture because BSD grep with --include treats it as rc=1, not rc=2, making that specific trigger non-portable) correctly FATALs count_literal(); a missing baseline file correctly FATALs read_baseline().

Обнаружено при построении self-test (7) для R-5: нельзя было использовать 'несуществующая директория как корень скана' как fixture для rc>=2 — на BSD grep (macOS /usr/bin/grep, дефолт на этой dev-машине) `grep -rn <pattern> <nonexistent-dir> --include='*.ts'` возвращает rc=1 (обрабатывается снисходительно как «нет подходящих файлов»), тогда как GNU grep для того же ввода возвращает rc=2 — использование этого триггера сделало бы self-test-ассерт флейки между платформами. Заменено на unreadable-file фикстуру (chmod 000) — портируемо даёт rc=2 на обоих grep-флейворах ('Permission denied'). DURABLE lesson: любой будущий rc>=2-self-test в этом репозитории обязан использовать permission-denied, не missing-directory-with-include, как cross-platform-надёжный триггер.
